藏品名称_EN: Apricot yellow satin tiger head type cotton wind hat
描述_EN: Apricot Yellow Satin Tiger Head Cotton Windbreaker，reign name of Qing emperor (1861-1875)，north-south (lines of longitude)50centimetre，harsh and unreasonable33centimetre，collection of old treasures from the Qing dynasty。　　Tiger head cap made of apricot yellow satin，Slightly oblong hat face，Looks like a little cape.。with a tiger's brow embroidered on the top hat、tiger's eye、leather nose、the web between the thumb and forefinger of a hand、The tiger's whiskers and other decorations and the symbol of the tiger's might.“best or strongest of its type”word。lined with moonlight-white silk，cotton lining。　　The shape of the tiger's head cap comes from ancient totem worship，Later, it became a good luck charm to ward off evil spirits.。The people use the shape of a tiger as a hat to pray for the peace and happiness of the children wearing it.、healthy growth。Children wear tiger hat not only has the practicality of cold protection and warmth，And it's also loved for its tiger-like shape.，Also highly decorative。Tiger head hat is a typical style of children's hat in the traditional children's clothing in China's folklore，Especially popular in the north。Generally more green、indigo plant、Pink fabric，Hat face made of hard cloth shell，And decorated with colorful silk thread embroidery.。　　This small tiger's head cap from the Qing Palace is made of fine materials.，It is more superior than the folk tiger's head beanie.，Judging from the Qing dress hierarchy, it should be worn by the youngest prince.。
描述_ZN: A small white glazed Xing Yao jug, Tang, 10.5 cm high, 2.5 cm in diameter, 5.3 cm in foot.　　The pot has a converging mouth, a short neck, a rounded belly, and a rounded footrim. There is a short stream on one side of the shoulder and a handle on the corresponding side, the upper end of the handle decorated with a decorative knot.　　This pot, with its small shape and white glaze, is a product of the Xing kiln in Hebei during the Tang dynasty.　　During the Tang Dynasty, Xing kiln was a famous porcelain kiln in the north, mainly burning white porcelain, and also burning yellow glaze, black glaze, three color varieties. Its products were not only for domestic use, but also exported to all over the world. The site of Xing Kiln is located in Xingzhou, Hebei Province, during the Tang Dynasty, with the central kiln site in the area of Chengguan, Neqiu County, Hebei Province, today. From the specimens unearthed by the kiln site investigation and excavation, it can be seen that Xing kiln white porcelain of the Tang Dynasty had fine and coarse varieties for the needs of different classes of people. As the Tang Dynasty Li Zhao "National Supplementary History" said: "Neiqiu white porcelain Ou, Duanxi purple stone ink stone, the world is not noble and common."
